HumanEval.empty_test_policy: Do not count empty tests as a pass. Qwen Auto and DeepSeek DSH adapter generate once and stop; native agents retain their stopping behavior.

MBPP.task_selection: 500 consecutive original task IDs 11 through 510 inclusive; not a random task sample
MBPP.public_test_selection: randomly choose one test from each task's original provided test list
MBPP.final_evaluation: all remaining provided tests, held out from generation and repair
MBPP.hidden_test_origin: held-out portion of the original MBPP tests, not an independently authored suite
MBPP.note: The author's confirmation supplies the visible/hidden split protocol absent from the export; no tests outside the selected public test are available during generation or repair.

BigCodeBench.sampling: random.Random(42).sample(full_rows, 150), then sort by task_id; frozen task IDs are authoritative
BigCodeBench.public_method_selection: Enumerate test_* methods in source order; int.from_bytes(SHA256(UTF8(protocol + ':' + seed + ':' + task_id)), 'big') modulo method count
retain: shared globals and mock patch targets
BigCodeBench.denominator: all 150 frozen tasks, including failures and timeouts

evaluation.native_and_DSH_adapter_isolation: new Bubblewrap namespace per candidate, no network or other task mounts
evaluation.candidate_policy: Freeze the last actually saved candidate before final evaluation; never choose candidates using final-test scores.
evaluation.averaging: Compute per-seed pass fraction on each fixed dataset, then average seeds; benchmark averages are unweighted across datasets, not pooled by task count.
